summary: A Lexis+ request failure must never look like a legal answer: a failed lookup is an ERROR (exit 5), not an unrecognized citation; an incomplete cite-check packet exits 6; a Shepard's report that cannot load negative history fails instead of omitting it; and a pin passes only when it covers every page of the quotation, with matching kept inside one opinion section.
reason: An attorney or script reads these results as cite-check conclusions, so an expired session, a partial packet, a missing reversal, or a quotation stitched across a majority and a dissent would otherwise pass as a clean check.
